# Coherent support admission without positive physical fault flags

29 October 2026. Root construction; independent challenge in progress.
Historical novelty UNKNOWN. These are conditional receiver theorems, not a
physical quantum-memory or fault-tolerant-computation demonstration.

## 1. Input that is actually required

On a finite set V of N labelled fault slots let F_M, M subset V, be one
CONSISTENT family of Hermiticity-preserving linear process maps. For the
fixed experiment, sum_M F_M is the actual CPTP process. All initial
environment registers, interventions and final receivers are included in
the map or admitted as common contractions in its complete strategy norm.
Assume, uniformly over the exogenous schedules used below,

    B(R) = sum_(M superset R) F_M,
    ||B(R)|| <= epsilon^|R|,       R subset V.                 (1)

F_M need not be CP. There is no positive probability law on M in this
assumption. The R=empty bound is just the norm-one physical full process.
Every support assertion below is an additional input; (1) alone does not
assert spatial locality, an ideal reference, or successful error correction.

For disjoint T,Z define a forced/forbidden hybrid by

    H(T,Z) = sum_(M: T subset M, M intersect Z=empty) F_M.

Finite inclusion-exclusion gives the useful exact identity and bound

    H(T,Z) = sum_(U subset Z) (-1)^|U| B(T union U),
    ||H(T,Z)|| <= epsilon^|T| (1+epsilon)^|Z|.          (2)

This explicitly pays the cost of forbidding faults on a boundary. It is
not an assumption that arbitrary normalized conditioned channels are close.

## 2. Cancellation for the component bad event

Fix ANY finite graph H on V, and integer d>=1. Put b(M)=1 if H[M] has a
connected component with >=d vertices, otherwise 0, and define

    a_R = sum_(S subset R) (-1)^(|R|-|S|) b(S).

Boolean inversion gives, as an exact identity of maps,

    sum_M b(M) F_M = sum_R a_R B(R).                        (3)

We have |a_R|<=2^|R|. More usefully, a_R=0 whenever H[R] has even ONE
component of size <d. Proof: g=1-b factorizes on the components C_i of
H[R], and its Mobius coefficient on R is the product of its coefficients
on the C_i. On a component of size <d, g is identically1 on all subsets;
its nonempty coefficient is (1-1)^|C_i|=0. For nonempty R the constant
function has zero coefficient, so a_R(b)=-a_R(g). Also a_empty=0.

Consequently

    ||sum_bad F_M||

29 October 2026. Derived extension of the ESTABLISHED Han et al.
arXiv2609.20537v1 AppendixC receiver argument. Independent challenge
in progress; its stronger physical-hybrid improvement is included below.
No generic qLDPC coherent threshold novelty is claimed.

## Exact assumptions

Let V be finite fault labels, each with declared source support X_v of
size<=q. Each physical source qubit belongs to at most D such supports.
Here D is the TOTAL incidence in this experiment, not incidence per unit
time. The stabilizer code has n qubits, distance d, and check-connectivity
graph Gamma of maximum degree Delta. Two qubits in one check are adjacent.

Let E encode into the code sector. Let G_M be maps from logical input to
the final physical source, with sum_M G_M an actual CPTP noise process,
and suppose

    ||sum_(M superset R) G_M||_diamond <= epsilon^|R|.     (1)

Assume an ENCODED-SUPPORT property: with S_M=union_(v in M) X_v,

    G_M(X) = sum_(P,Q supported on S_M) c_(P,Q,M)
                                  P E(X) Q^dagger.        (2)

The scalar coefficients can be signed/complex, correlated across M,
and need not come from independent local environments. No CP property of
G_M is required. Environment outputs have been traced out. This assumption
does not follow from (1) alone. Interleaved nominal Pauli correction which
spreads the common error is not granted by (2).

scopes below.** This is a whole analytical challenge, not an extrapolation
from the finite consumer. No further model, trajectory, bath, or numerical
parameter case was run by this reviewer.

paragraphs were reread after the last amendment. The separate nominal CLOCK
environment and the independent free Gaussian DATA baths are now explicit

it does not hide additional check-conditioned couplings to the same fields.
That distinction is necessary for the specified free-correlation Wick proof.

## 1. What was reconstructed

The following checks are theorem-level; the finite diagnostic is separate.

**Boolean cancellation and asynchronous enumeration.** For nonempty R the
Mobius coefficient of the large-component event is the negative coefficient
of its good indicator. The latter factorizes over the induced components of
H[R]. Any component smaller than d supplies the zero nonempty coefficient
of a constant function. Thus all surviving components have size at least d,
and the coefficient bound 2^|R| is valid without positive fault flags.

I supplied the explicit deferred-decision proof in
